tree: Lead management software captures every inquiry in one place, then helps your team qualify it, assign an owner and track the next step until the lead is won or closed.
Inquiries arrive by phone, form and social media, and some never get a reply.
Every lead lands in one list with an owner and a next step, so none slip through.
Lead sources flow into one lead list.
A simple, structured process to capture, qualify, assign and follow up — so no lead is ever lost.
Get the full picture of every lead.
See contact details, activity history, notes, tasks and more — so your team has everything they need to take the next step.
Interested in scheduling a consultation for their business. Prefers afternoon calls.
Capture leads from different channels and manage them in a consistent way.
Route leads to the right people.
Automatically assign leads based on your rules — by location, source, interest or any custom criteria.
Set rules to assign each lead to the right team member.
Leads are assigned automatically based on your rules
Works for different teams and businesses.
Whether you run a local business, a service company or a growing team, Noxtill Lead Management helps you stay organized and respond faster.
